item.title: Iran live updates: Trump says he is considering 'winding down’ Iran military efforts
item.summary: President Donald Trump announced "major combat operations" against Iran on Feb. 28, with massive joint U.S.-Israel strikes.

item.title: WATCH: Rise in gas prices show no sign of slowing down, analyst says
item.summary: GasBuddy's head of petroleum analysis, Patrick De Haan, says price increases are becoming "far more problematic" every day the war in Iran continues.

item.title: WATCH: Meteorite hunter chases down Ohio meteor hit
item.summary: Roberto Vargas, a meteorite hunter, joins ABC News Live from his car as he attempts to chase down the exact site a meteor caused a boom over Ohio in hopes of finding any rare space rocks left behind.

item.title: WATCH: Punch the monkey seen cuddling fellow monkey fans dub "girlfriend"
item.summary: After capturing hearts across the world with his affection towards a stuffed orangutan, Punch the monkey has been seen cuddling up with a fellow monkey in his enclosure.

item.title: LIVE: ABC News Live
item.summary: 24/7 coverage of breaking news and live events

item.title: WATCH: New York State trooper involved in chain reaction crash during traffic stop
item.summary: The trooper in Mamaroneck was injured during a traffic stop when a SUV slammed into his patrol car, pushing it into another vehicle and hitting him. The incident is under investigation.

item.title: WATCH: Rhode Island high school hockey team wins state title after deadly ice rink shooting
item.summary: David Muir reports on young hockey star Colin Dorgan – who lost his family in the deadly Rhode Island ice rink shooting – scoring a key goal in the game to help his team win in quadruple overtime.

item.title: DOJ asks judge to drop charges against 2 officers in Breonna Taylor case
item.summary: The DOJ asked a court to drop charges against two former officers accused of providing false information on a search warrant that led to the 2020 Breonna Taylor raid.

item.title: Surfer speaks out after shark attack
item.summary: Jason Eastman was attacked by a shark and sustained bites in both legs while surfing off the coast of Big River Beach in Mendocino, California.

item.title: WATCH: New details on drones over Air Force base
item.summary: A drone sighting that temporarily raised alarms at a U.S. Air Force airfield was more extensive than first reported, per a confidential internal briefing document reviewed by ABC News.
